key_phrases: improvement in advertiser spend across all geographies
high level of investment in Cloud
analysis.reasoning: The company showed strong top-line growth (14% YoY) and a recovery in advertiser spending despite the pandemic. Management expressed high confidence in their AI roadmap and Cloud expansion, with specific emphasis on long-term investment in CapEx and engineering. While regulatory risks (DOJ) were acknowledged, they were framed as manageable. The QA session was direct, particularly regarding Cloud profitability and hardware strategy, though some specific margin details for Cloud were deferred to future calls.
